note: Hand-maintained map of design-bench screen item id -> product route on QA_STAND_URL. An item with no entry has no verified product adapter and its contact sheet stays incomplete. Add an entry only after loading the route on a stand: { "path": "/x", "identity": { "selector": "#x", "attribute": "data-screen", "value": "x" }, "revisionHeader": "x-tracy-revision", "locales": { "en": "", "vi": "?lang=vi" }, "localeProof": { "en": { "selector": "h1", "includes": "<English text>" }, "vi": { "selector": "h1", "includes": "<Vietnamese text>" } } }. A capture counts only when the page stays on the path, the identity element carries the declared attribute value, the consumer shows the locale-proof text, the light theme is in effect and the named header states the revision.
